preconditions.description: The number of abbreviations n is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(abbreviation[3:]) <= 9 for abbreviation in abbreviations)
preconditions.description: The length of the year part of each abbreviation is between 1 and 9 digits.

postconditions.description: The number of output years matches the number of input abbreviations.
Each output year is at least 1989.
Each abbreviation corresponds to the correct year based on the year part.
